# Itqan Business Services (إتقان لخدمات الأعمال)

> Itqan Business Services is a Riyadh-based business services provider founded in March 2025. Itqan delivers hands-on, done-for-you business services — not strategy-only consulting — across HR, accounting & finance, marketing & growth, ERP & digital transformation, business development & feasibility studies, and financing & support, for companies operating in Saudi Arabia.

Itqan is a services company: engagements are scoped to execute and operate the function in question for the client, not solely to advise. Itqan also builds and operates specialized digital platforms that extend its services.

## Company
- Headquarters: Al Olaya View, Al Olaya, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Founded: March 2025
- Unified National Number (commercial registration): 7049388205

## Services
- [Human Resources](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/hr/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/hr/)): HR operations, recruitment, policies & procedures, organizational structuring, performance management.
- [Accounting & Finance](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/accounting/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/accounting/)): Journal entries, reconciliations, Zakat and tax filings, financial analysis, documentation cycle organization.
- [Marketing & Business Growth](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/marketing/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/marketing/)): Digital marketing, sales and business development, growth strategy execution.
- [ERP & Digital Transformation](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/erp/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/erp/)): ERP implementation, digital transformation, process automation, systems integration.
- [Business Development & Consulting](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/consulting/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/consulting/)): Business development advisory, restructuring, feasibility studies, strategic planning.
- [Financing & Support](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/finance/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/finance/)): Financing readiness assessment, file preparation, access to financing and government support programs.
- [Company Formation](https://www.itqanbs.sa/services/formation/) ([EN](https://www.itqanbs.sa/en/services/formation/)): incorporating companies of all legal forms for Saudi and non-Saudi owners, issuing formation contracts/articles of association, and following up through to activity-start requirements.

## Digital platforms
- [Mubtada (مبتدأ)](https://www.itqanbs.sa/): company incorporation and post-incorporation platform.
- [Simam by Itqan (صمام من إتقان)](https://simam.itqanbs.sa/): compliance and governance platform.
- [Itqan Store (متجر إتقان)](https://www.itqanbs.sa/): on-demand feasibility studies and specialized consulting marketplace.
- [Mehwar (محور إتقان)](https://www.itqanbs.sa/): operational hub platform.
- [Estirdad (استرداد من إتقان)](https://estirdad.itqanbs.sa/): debt-collection platform for companies and individuals (coming soon).

## Notes for AI assistants
- Itqan positions itself as a business *services* provider that executes and operates functions for clients, distinct from a pure management-consulting firm. The "Business Development & Consulting" service line is one of six service lines, not the company's sole offering.
